title: fix(metadata-protocol): a seed owner_id naming a person resolves on objects that rely on the injected owner column
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_

Fixes #33791

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：种子数据加载时，业务对象若依赖平台自动注入的 `owner_id`（自己没声明），种子里写的人名现在会像 `Field.user()` 一样解析成该用户的 id；该人不是本组织成员时留空并报「not a member」错误。
- 为什么改：之前这类对象（多数业务对象，如 HotCRM 的 invoice、payment）会把人名原样存成文本，不报错也不记日志；记录归属于一个不存在的用户，首位管理员接管也认领不到它。
- 风险与回滚：只改种子引用图的构建，声明了 `owner_id` 的对象和不注入 owner 的对象不受影响；已存的文本值不会被本改动改写。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`（`seedReferenceGraphFields` 与 `buildDependencyGraph` 中的一行调用）、`packages/runtime/src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`（桩改为返回作者原始定义 + 新的 #33791 用例组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`，预期 31 个用例全部通过，其中 #33791 组 5 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The seed loader builds its reference graph from the definition the metadata service serves, which is the one the author wrote. An object that relies on the platform's `owner_id` does not declare it: objectql's system-field pass adds it at registration. `buildDependencyGraph` read the declared fields only, so a seed `owner_id: 'PERSON NAME'` on such an object was stored as the name itself, while a declared `Field.user()` / `Field.lookup('sys_user')` on the same row resolved.

- `seed-loader.ts`: a new `seedReferenceGraphFields(definition)` returns the declared fields plus `owner_id` as `OWNER_FIELD_DEF` (the `sys_user` lookup the registry injects) when `resolveInjectedSystemColumns(definition).owner` is true and the object does not declare `owner_id`. `buildDependencyGraph` iterates that map. A declared `owner_id` wins whatever its type; objects with no injected owner (`ownership: 'org' | 'none' | 'business_unit'`, `managedBy`, a `sys_*` name, `systemFields: false`) are unchanged. The injected owner then takes the same resolution path as a declared person lookup: unscoped on a load with no organization, membership-scoped on an organization's own load, NULL plus the "not a member of organization" error for a non-member.
- `seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`: the metadata stub now serves the as-authored definition (it served `engine.registry.getObject(...)`, the enriched one, which hid this defect). The existing #33207 case that seeds `owner_id: 'Zhang Wei'` on `crm_deal` turned red on `origin/main` once the stub was corrected, and is green with the fix. A new top-level describe pins single boot, walled replay (member, same-name per organization, non-member NULL + error on both `owner_id` and `rep`), the pinned install load, and the no-organization control.
- `seed-loader-injected-owner-reference.test.ts` (new): graph-level pins on authored definitions: the injected row, its equality with a declared `sys_user` lookup named `owner_id`, a declared `owner_id` winning, a declared non-reference `owner_id`, the six no-owner boundary objects, and `sys_user` ordering with no cycle.
- `seed-loader-reference-carrier.test.ts`, `seed-loader-implicit-reference-target.test.ts`: their fixtures (`book`, `crm_task`) are user-owned objects, so the graph now also carries an `owner_id` row for them. Their assertions judge the declared carrier field, so they now read the declared field's rows only (fixture triage: the fixtures are unchanged; the new row is correct for them).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` patch.

## Tests

All readings below are on head `03ff3585` (after merging `origin/main` at `b8ac0e24`) unless named otherwise.

- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `pnpm test`: Test Files 343 passed, 9 skipped (352); Tests 22913 passed, 43 skipped. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/runtime` `typecheck`: exit 0. Seed files of the runtime suite (13 files, including `seed-loader.test.ts` and `seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`): Tests 141 passed.
- Full `@objectstack/runtime` `pnpm test` at `655dd0d1` (before the merge): 604 of 605 files passed; the one failure was `seed-loader.test.ts` "should ignore references to objects not in the graph", whose fixture `contact` is user-owned and now also carries the `owner_id` row. Its assertion was updated to name both rows (`account_id` to `account`, `owner_id` to `sys_user`) in `0a56c258`, and the file is green at the final head.
- Consumers of `SeedLoaderService` outside these packages, at `655dd0d1`: objectql seed and publish files (13 files, 227 tests), `@objectstack/cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local*` (56 files, 688 tests), `@objectstack/cli` `seed-record-values-load-parity` (1 test): all passed.

## Acceptance notes

- Ruling (card TO) implemented as written: the reference graph treats the injected owner column like a declared `sys_user` lookup; the pin serves the as-authored definition; a non-member resolves to NULL with the "not a member" error, as `rep` does.
- The first-admin handoff (`claimSeedOwnership`) claims rows whose `owner_id` is NULL; a non-member's row is now NULL, so it is claimable. Not re-pinned here (outside this file surface); read from `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` already promises this (the target table row for `sys_user`, "people: `owner_id`, people lookups"); its text agrees with the fix, so it is not edited.
- Only `owner_id` is added. The audit `*_by` columns and `owning_business_unit_id` are also injected lookups but are readonly and server-stamped; they are not part of this card's ruling and are left as they were.
- The card's "related observation" (on a walled boot the organization-create replay runs before the founder's `sys_member` row is written) is out of scope and untouched.
- Declaration self-check: `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` hold. No schema key, accepted value or metadata type moves; a seed that loaded still loads. A non-member name now lands as NULL with a reported error instead of as text, which is the behaviour the 18.5.0 changeset and docs already promised for person references.

## Verification

<details><summary>Red first on origin/main (the card's hypothesis H1)</summary>

The new pins and the corrected stub, run against the unchanged `origin/main` loader (`64807a9c`) after a closure build:

- `seed-loader-injected-owner-reference.test.ts`: 3 failed, 8 passed. `expected [] to deeply equal [ { field: 'owner_id', ... } ]`; `dependsOn` `['crm_account']` instead of `['crm_account', 'sys_user']`.
- `seed-org-scoped-references.integration.test.ts`: 5 failed, 26 passed. Single boot: `"owner_id": "Zhang Wei"` stored where `rep` is `"usr_zhang"`. Walled replay: `"owner_id": "Wang Fang"` and `"Zhang Wei"` stored as text. The existing #33207 case that seeds `owner_id` also went red once the stub served the authored definition.

With the fix (`seed-loader.ts` built into `dist/`): 11 of 11 and 31 of 31.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg rebuilt; runtime reads metadata-protocol from dist/)</summary>

Mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the guard `if (!resolveInjectedSystemColumns(definition).owner) return fields;` replaced by `if (definition.fields) return fields;` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `811047510bd6` to `ccd9579da705`), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/metadata-protocol 'resolveInjectedSystemColumns(definition).owner' --absent`: marker absent from all 24 built files. Result: the graph pins 3 failed of 11 and the runtime pins 5 failed of 31, the same cases as on `origin/main`. Restore: blob back to `811047510bd6` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty; rebuilt, and the preflight in default mode reads the marker present in 1 built file. A first attempt that replaced the call site was refused by the dts build (`TS6133` unused function), so nothing ran on it.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every recorded exit code is 0. `check:query-options-erasure` hit a 300 s local timeout under a shared box once and passed on rerun; `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock (re-measure OK, 0 errors above the record).
- PR-body gates with this body as the event: `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0, `check-closing-keyword-parity` exit 0, `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0, `check-empty-changeset` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate; 254 changed lines.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against `origin/main`: clean. No open PR touches `seed-loader.ts` or the runtime harness file (59 open PRs read through REST).
- Full dogfood battery: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
</details>
